status: Bungie has not released a public Marathon API yet, so live player stats, vault access and loadout equipping are not possible. RankSurge will add them as soon as Bungie opens an API.

season.nextNote: Bungie folded the planned Season 3 into the Symbiosis update. It adds the Bishop Runner shell and new weapons and equipment.

statsNote: Weapon stats are the launch values Bungie showed in game (March 2026). Balance patches since launch may have changed some numbers, so check in game before you commit to a build.
metaNote: Tiers are the RankSurge team's summary of current public tier lists (shells: July to August 2026, weapons: October 2026). The meta shifts with every patch.

prime: Charges tendrils that revive downed teammates from range, or hit enemies with an EMP.
tact: Sends out up to three drones that heal teammates' health and shields over time.
traits: Shareware.exe
Patch Kit and Shield Charger healing is shared with teammates who have a drone.
Battery Overcharge
Briefly boosts your weapons at the cost of Heat. Volt weapons that break a shield also EMP the target.
shells.why: The only shell that can bring a whole squad back into a fight, which makes it a core pick for teams.

prime: Throws smoke grenades that block vision for anyone inside.
tact: Turns you invisible for a short time. Moving fast makes you easier to see, and shooting, using items or taking damage breaks it.
traits: Shadow Dive
Dropping to the ground from mid-air leaves a smoke cloud.
Shroud
You are invisible inside smoke and for a moment after you leave it.
shells.why: Picks fights on its own terms and slips away from bad ones, so it leads solo play.

prime: Sends sonar pulses that reveal nearby players and UESC enemies, even invisible ones.
tact: A spider drone runs at enemies and explodes, overheating them and adding burn damage.
traits: Interrogation
Warns you when an enemy pings you. Finishing an enemy pings their teammates.
Stalker Protocol
After you break an enemy's shield, their footprints stay visible for a short time.
shells.why: Hard counter to stealth shells and gives the whole squad information, which matters most in ranked.

abilities: Mines stick to surfaces and lock down enemies who set them off.
A short-range radar that marks nearby enemies through walls on your HUD.
Better resistance after splash damage, and better close-range handling when enemies surround you.
shells.why: Locks down rooms and chokepoints, and the radar is strong in dark zones like Night Marsh.

prime: Fly a drone that zaps players and UESC robots to knock loot out of their backpacks.
tact: Fires a grappling hook that pulls you to a spot.
traits: X-Ray Visor
Shows loot containers through walls, colored by rarity, and highlights enemies. Aiming at an enemy disrupts their vision.
The Finer Things
Better weapon handling and faster grapple recharge the more items you carry.
shells.why: The best shell for finding and stealing high-value loot, with a grapple to get out.

prime: Boosts movement speed and weapon handling and cuts the Heat from movement abilities for a short time.
tact: Fires a blast that knocks enemies away. Charge it longer for a bigger, stronger blast.
traits: Microjets
Double jump, at an extra Heat cost.
Powerslide
Slide farther and faster, at an extra Heat cost.
shells.why: The fastest shell in the game if you can manage its Heat, which makes it high reward and hard to master.

prime: Shoulder pods fire homing missiles that lock down enemies you have already damaged.
tact: A front-facing energy shield that blocks damage. Its cooldown grows the longer you hold it and the more damage it takes.
traits: Thruster
A sideways dash that also works in the air.
Tactical Sprint
A faster sprint that builds more Heat.
shells.why: Simple and tough in straight fights, but easier to outplay than the top shells.

shells.best: New players and quick solo runs
prime: Slowly restores health. Taking damage interrupts it.
tact: Hides you from UESC robots. Running or taking damage breaks it.
shells.limits: Solo only and joins matches already in progress. Rook cannot progress contracts or use vault gear; it drops in with random basic gear that improves with faction upgrades.
shells.why: A low-risk way to drop in, grab loot and learn the maps without risking your vault.
Bungie has named Bishop as the new shell in Symbiosis but has not shared its abilities yet. RankSurge will add them on launch day.

weapons.note: A pistol-frame SMG made for close fights and stopping shotgun rushes. Bungie has not published its stats.

weapons.why: Stable, easy-to-control fire for mid-range duels.
Hits hard at medium range if you can control the recoil.
One-shot threat that controls open ground at long range.
Deadly in tight rooms and corridors.
Strips shields fast so a teammate can finish.
Reliable backup for finishing weakened enemies up close.
Wins most close-quarters fights and suits players who push first.
Strong damage per trigger pull at range.
Precise mid-range burst rifle that anchors team fights.

loadouts.why: Push rooms and corridors: the SMG wins short fights and the shotgun ends them.
A mid-range rifle for open ground plus an SMG for when fights close in.
Hold lanes with the sniper and fall back on the heavy assault rifle at medium range.
Steady mid-range fire while you heal, with a shield-breaking shotgun for anyone who rushes you.
Cheap, common weapons on a tough, easy-to-play shell, for a low-risk run when you don't want to spend your best vault gear.
